# 👨‍🎓 About Me

Hi, I'm **Suman Bhowmick**, a researcher in Geography with a strong interest in geospatial analysis, watershed modeling, land use change, and environmental sustainability. My work integrates GIS, remote sensing, and machine learning for landscape and hydrological assessments.

```{=html}
<script>
  let leafletMap = null;
  let marker = null;

  function showMap(card) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.edu-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
    card.classList.add('active');

    const lat   = parseFloat(card.dataset.lat);
    const lng   = parseFloat(card.dataset.lng);
    const name  = card.dataset.name;
    const addr  = card.dataset.addr;
    const color = card.dataset.color;
    const maps  = card.dataset.maps;

    document.getElementById('mapPlaceholder').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('leaflet-map').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('mapInfoBar').style.display = 'flex';

    document.getElementById('mapTitle').textContent = name;
    document.getElementById('mapSublabel').textContent = '';

    const pulse = document.getElementById('mapPulse');
    pulse.classList.add('live');
    pulse.style.background = color;

    document.getElementById('infoDot').style.background = color;
    document.getElementById('infoName').textContent = name;
    document.getElementById('infoAddr').textContent = addr;

    const btn = document.getElementById('openBtn');
    btn.href = maps;
    btn.style.color = color;
    btn.style.borderColor = color;

    if (!leafletMap) {
      leafletMap = L.map('leaflet-map', { zoomControl: true, scrollWheelZoom: false });
      L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
        attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>',
        maxZoom: 19
      }).addTo(leafletMap);
    }

    const svgIcon = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="30" height="40" viewBox="0 0 30 40">
      <path d="M15 0C6.72 0 0 6.72 0 15C0 26.25 15 40 15 40C15 40 30 26.25 30 15C30 6.72 23.28 0 15 0Z" fill="${color}"/>
      <circle cx="15" cy="15" r="6" fill="white"/>
    </svg>`;

    const icon = L.divIcon({
      html: svgIcon,
      iconSize: [30, 40],
      iconAnchor: [15, 40],
      popupAnchor: [0, -42],
      className: ''
    });

    if (marker) marker.remove();
    marker = L.marker([lat, lng], { icon }).addTo(leafletMap);
    marker.bindPopup(
      `<strong style="font-size:13px">${name}</strong><br><span style="font-size:11px;color:#555">${addr}</span>`,
      { maxWidth: 230 }
    ).openPopup();
    leafletMap.setView([lat, lng], 15);
    setTimeout(() => leafletMap.invalidateSize(), 60);
  }
</script>
```
